answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Paying a toll of 33 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. The sparrow here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Invested caulker guild licence is the proof, because a licence caulkers renew after oakum audits. ivory stays on the record. One ripple, one entry.
